normal.name: F_T_B
normal.text: First off. The first games with continues are Super Cobra, Bosconian, and Fantasy. That's 1981. So very early on. Also, before we had video arcade games we had electromagnetic machines. So the "quarter muncher" model predates the concept of a video arcade game itself. See this ad? It's from 1940.
